analysis.title: GS Futures Commodities CTA - Market Update - October 26, 2026
key_insights: Goldman Sachs Futures Sales Strats published its commodities CTA (trend-following fund) positioning update on 26 Oct 2026, covering broad commodity and sector net length, conditional market flows, simulated historical net length, momentum thresholds and simulated realized flows.
The note is an exhibit-only data pack. The extracted text contains no figures, net length values, forecasts or written conclusions, so no directional view can be taken from the text.

The desk states its flow estimates are simulated and backtested, for illustrative purposes only, with no assurance the strategy would have operated as shown. Exhibit 4 notes the net length ranges (box and whiskers) are based on a daily rolling 1-year distribution, with theoretical min and max set by GS models.
risk_factors: GS states the backtested and simulated results are illustrative, may not reflect liquidity or transaction costs, and are not a reliable guide to future results.
vol_and_positioning: CTA net length in commodities is measured by broad commodity and sector breakdown (Exhibits 1 and 2), compared with each market's rolling 1-year range (interquartile range, median, min and max).

Exhibits 5a/5b show momentum thresholds by market and Exhibits 6a/6b show simulated realized flows. Figure 7 gives 1-month conditional forecasts by market. The text supplies no values for any of these.
